description: This file defines classes for the Informix database driver within the ADODB database abstraction library, specifically for PHP. It extends existing classes for Informix 7.2, adding support for features like the 'FIRST' TOP clause and the NVL function for null handling, and provides a recordset class tailored for Informix.

classes.name: ADODB_informix
classes.description: Database driver class for Informix, supporting the 'SELECT FIRST' syntax and NVL function.

classes.name: ADORecordset_informix
classes.description: Recordset class for Informix, extending the base Informix 7.2 recordset with specific configurations.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Returns the NVL SQL expression for null value replacement specific to Informix 9.X and 10.X.

methods.name: ADODBRecordset_informix
methods.description: Constructor for the Informix-specific recordset class.
